Class ClientPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.client.ClientPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ClientPlayer extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the client-side local state of a player in the game. Stores player data, resources, tribe cards, and connection status.
